Deploy rtvi-cv-3d using CALIBRATION_JSON=/data/mv3dt/calibration.json, MODELS_DIR=/data/vss-app-data/models, BEV_DATASET_PATH=/data/mv3dt/bev-dataset, and these MP4s: Camera_01=/data/mv3dt/videos/front.mp4 Camera_02=/data/mv3dt/videos/left.mp4 Camera_03=/data/mv3dt/videos/right.mp4 Camera_04=/data/mv3dt/videos/back.mp4. checks: The plan uses deployment path services/rtvi/rt-cv-3d/rt-cv-mv3dt/docker/compose.yml.
The plan validates calibration camera sensors using type == camera, safe unique IDs, and NUM_CAMS=4.
The plan creates generated symlinks named <sensor_id>.mp4 for the supplied MP4 mapping without mutating source videos.
The plan writes standalone docker/.env with MODELS_DIR, NUM_CAMS=4, INPUT_MODE=file, and VIDEO_DIR set for the standalone package.
The plan reports runtime images only from docker compose config --images and does not hardcode image tags.

The plan runs bundled resource preflight before generate-configs.sh or stage-configs.sh: it reuses existing standalone containers without rewriting broker ports, rejects foreign fixed-name collisions, and for a fresh start selects free Kafka, MQTT, and DeepStream REST ports in docker/.env.
The plan checks ffprobe before saved-output verification and checks BEV visualizer Python/OpenCV/Kafka dependencies before starting saved BEV.
The plan includes starting bundled brokers and bev-fusion first, verifies health/topic init, records a run id/start timestamp, then captures Kafka offset baselines before starting perception.

After staging, the plan asserts generated/configs/ds-main-config-mv3dt.txt has msg-broker-conn-str matching the selected KAFKA_BOOTSTRAP and RAW_TOPIC, so a fallback port such as 19092 is not staged as stale 9092.

The plan starts the BEV recorder after file-mode Kafka baselines in the same long-lived shell/session that continues through perception, EOS, verification, and BEV finalization; it does not rely on a standalone short tool call with nohup. It waits for Kafka consumer group assignment evidence, verifies the recorder PID is still alive, then starts perception with docker compose up -d --no-deps --force-recreate perception so Kafka/Mosquitto are not recreated.
The plan uses bounded validation/readiness checks for Compose startup, broker/topic readiness, BEV Fusion health, Kafka baselines, and perception startup before reporting deployment success.
For file input, the agent does not require ds-ready: YES; it treats Exited (0) with App run successful as EOS success and requires mdx-raw and mdx-bev offsets to exceed baselines.
The plan warns that first-run TensorRT engine builds can take 5-10 minutes, checks/remediates model-cache writeability, and avoids broad chmod/chown permission changes.

The plan waits for the tracked saved-BEV recorder to exit/finalize, safely SIGTERMs the validated recorder if needed, then reports only current-run video-output/grid-view.mkv and current-run BEV output after timestamp/size/ffprobe checks and BEV log Video saved positive-frame evidence.
The plan stops remaining standalone support services for completed file-input runs unless the user asked to keep them running.
The agent does not actually run docker compose, docker pull, docker run, ngc download, curl against services, or modify runtime files for this planning eval.

Deploy RTVI-CV-3D with external MQTT broker broker.example.com:1883 and external Kafka kafka.example.com:19092. Do not use bundled brokers. Use CALIBRATION_JSON=/data/mv3dt/calibration.json, MODELS_DIR=/data/vss-app-data/models, BEV_DATASET_PATH=/data/mv3dt/bev-dataset, and these MP4s: Camera_01=/data/mv3dt/videos/front.mp4 Camera_02=/data/mv3dt/videos/left.mp4 Camera_03=/data/mv3dt/videos/right.mp4 Camera_04=/data/mv3dt/videos/back.mp4. checks: The plan collects/validates MQTT_HOST=broker.example.com, MQTT_PORT=1883, and KAFKA_BOOTSTRAP=kafka.example.com:19092 before deployment.
The plan sets USE_EXTERNAL_BROKERS=1 and exports MQTT_HOST, MQTT_PORT, and KAFKA_BOOTSTRAP for child Python/config-generation processes.

The plan includes running MQTT_BROKERS=broker.example.com:1883 ./scripts/generate-configs.sh and verifies generated/pub_sub_info_config.yml contains broker.example.com:1883 using the utility venv Python.

The plan uses external-broker Compose mode without COMPOSE_PROFILES=mosquitto,kafka and, because this is file mode, starts perception only after baselines and BEV assignment using docker compose up -d --no-deps --force-recreate perception.
The plan uses bounded kafka-topics --describe checks to require mdx-raw and mdx-bev topics on the external KAFKA_BOOTSTRAP before starting bev-fusion or perception.
The plan verifies mdx-raw and mdx-bev offsets against the external KAFKA_BOOTSTRAP with Kafka CLI offset checks.
The plan uses bounded validation/readiness checks for external Kafka topics, Compose startup, BEV Fusion health, Kafka baselines, and perception startup before reporting deployment success.
The generated runtime pub/sub endpoint is broker.example.com:1883; the agent does not claim the existing startup sed rewrite supports hostnames.
Advanced TLS/auth is delegated to the standalone README custom-broker section.
The agent does not actually run docker compose, docker pull, docker run, ngc download, curl against services, or modify runtime files for this planning eval.
